title: Variable FIR Interpolation
text: Polyphase FIR interpolation with tunable interpolation factor, 3 inputs, 1 output, no direct feedthrough, {Numerator source} sets FIR filter coefficient source; {Specification} sets the mode to control interpolation factor Interpolation, {Maximum interpolation factor}, {Specify interpolation factor from input port}, {Interpolation factor}, {Output frame length}, {Prototype filter numerator coefficients} sets the prototype filter coefficients, {View Filter Response} and {Simulate using} sets the type of simulation to run Interpreted. Values come from the instance.
